column1: # Partition layout for the Slave firmware on a 4MB flash (Waveshare ESP32-S3-Zero).
# Needed because the esp32-s3-devkitc-1 board profile defaults to an 8/16MB layout
# last partition runs past the end of a 4MB chip - the bootloader then rejects the whole
# table ("partition N invalid - ... exceeds flash chip size") and the device bootloops.
# Two OTA app slots (the Master can trigger remote updates via CMD_TRIGGER_UPDATE)
